summary: Central Plains Bancshares, Inc. (CPBI) filed an 8-K on July 30, 2026, announcing that its Board approved a new stock repurchase program of up to 10% of outstanding shares, subject to regulatory approval. The move follows a prior buyback and aims to return capital to shareholders. A press release dated July 29, 2026 was attached as Exhibit 99.1. The program is a discretionary capital return, not a tender offer; it requires federal bank regulator approval. Watch for regulatory clearance and execution pace; the source of funds is likely existing cash or future earnings, with no fixed expiration disclosed.
